scientific_integrity: Proof uses a weighted isotonic reduction, exact Jacobian row sums, full pooling with strict complementarity, and an analytic weight range argument. Finite exact-rational checks supplement rather than prove the universal statement. Historical priority and independent validation are not certified.
scientific_limitations: Real complete two-row arrays with strictly positive heteroscedastic quadratic weights; supermodularity in fixed order; deterministic unweighted-coordinate sup-norm error. No assertion for three or more rows or arbitrary missing cells.
title: Exact coordinatewise stability of weighted two-row supermodular regression
